label: At the named standpoint, either every accessible world satisfies G or every accessible world fails…
paraphrase: At the named standpoint, either every accessible world satisfies G or every accessible world fails G (□G ∨ □¬G). Coverage does not itself assert exclusivity or select a side.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: With the same case instance of G as planned for the necessary-existence horn (G v := some m.concrete GOD_4 satisfier exists at v), use a possibility premise for that instance to exclude the impossibility horn, then apply the de dicto to de re bridge and reflexivity at w to reach NecessaryConcreteAt.
connection_plan.blocker: No case instance of G, no possibility premise for it and no de re bridge are formalized. Coverage alone does not choose a horn: the reverse possibility premise selects impossibility with equal formal right.
